decision: Accept the local reproduction evidence with stated limits. Keep tiny2 rejected, production unchanged, and WAN on hold pending a materially justified candidate; no retry-until-pass.
does_not_prove: The exact tiny2 interleaving, plaintext identity of either 34-byte record, or that the record was a TLS close_notify.
A kernel RawConn.Control failure: TCP captures are synthetic; tested TLS transport is net.Pipe.
That observer overhead caused tiny2, or a quantitative perturbation bound.
Absence of every possible race, leak or shutdown defect outside the two executed schedules.
A guaranteed no-error natural close with live control producers or an established no-future-write barrier.
Any throughput improvement, 90 percent download gate result, WAN qualification, release readiness or production remediation.
forced_overlap_limit: The fixture deliberately holds after-capture until body/physical Close completes. Existing close_race/ambiguous/invalid flags are expected in that schedule and differ from tiny2 final raw/TCP complete=true, invalid=false, ambiguous=false. It demonstrates a compatible lifecycle mechanism, not an exact flag-for-flag WAN reproduction.
join_limit: Session.Close return and retirement establish the source-defined completion-channel contract for send/receive loops and aggregate publisher, plus its ping-reply wait. This is not runtime enumeration of every goroutine.
preserved_preparation_failure: Native-envelope metadata writer initially failed Python parsing; its failure artifact is retained and reports no Go execution. The corrected envelope did not rerun either test stage.
production_fix_reason: Expected cancellation of an active control write is not a demonstrated ownership or lifecycle defect. Neither schedule shows failure to join, retained active ownership after retirement, or a violated existing shutdown contract. Reordering Close to wait for a blocked writer risks deadlock and changes cancellation semantics.
proves: In both forced schedules, the actual TLS/Yamux Session.Close path completes its existing join/retirement contract and all explicit fixture workers return before failure cleanup.
A blocked raw write can be interrupted by intentional Close and retains its error and zero written bytes.

A raw write can finish successfully while its surrounding TLS Write remains active in after-capture; concurrent Close can leave a failed simulated after-capture without changing the raw success result.
Existing observer logic conservatively retains close-race, incomplete/invalid evidence and the actual write result instead of promoting cancellation to a congestion-control transition.
The tested schedules completed with the race detector enabled without a reported race.
review_kind: Astra bounded architectural and retained-result review
review_operations: Read retained source, invocation, native envelope, lifecycle, result and JSON test logs.
Independently verified every records-ledger entry and expected ledger/result hashes.
Compared pre/post input documents for exact equality and independently parsed exact run/pass names.
scope: Local cancellation correctness reproduction only; no acceptance of tiny2, WAN qualification, performance or production fix.

smallest_remaining_prerequisite.admissible_future_candidate: Would need to stop admitting new work and resolve outstanding work through an established bounded lifecycle contract while retaining the ability to interrupt an unresponsive peer; no such implementation is proposed or authorized by this review.
smallest_remaining_prerequisite.current_status: No such candidate is established by these results. The justified validator-only correction changes diagnosis, not the write/close behavior.
smallest_remaining_prerequisite.first_decision: Determine whether any actual contract violation remains to fix from available source/evidence. If none can be identified, record this qualification path as blocked under its current no-error requirement instead of manufacturing a production change or sampling shutdown until it happens to pass.
not_sufficient: Another unchanged tiny/WAN run after the validator correction.
Calling shutdown errors healthy, skipping post-close records or relaxing the raw error gate.
An arbitrary idle wait, endpoint stop-order swap or qualification-only drain barrier.
A single healthy snapshot while control producers remain live.
smallest_remaining_prerequisite.required: A concrete, reviewed, evidence-backed hypothesis and candidate that addresses the remaining final raw-write error or establishes a relevant changed condition, with a bounded local demonstration that preserves existing cancellation, ownership and fixed validation gates. Freeze the candidate and a single predeclared WAN experiment before any new WAN execution.

tiny2_disposition: Rejected and preserved. Natural endpoint/process joins and exact completed transfers do not override final raw error rejection.

validator_context.full_tiny2_revalidation: Coordinator reports rejection remains exactly for lane4 outside write error; this final review did not rerun the validator.
validator_context.interpretation: Removing a false congestion-control mismatch diagnosis cannot erase the independently recorded write error or turn tiny2 into an accepted run.
